title: BEATS: Bias Evaluation and Assessment Test Suite for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the presence and frequency of religion bias in Large Language Model responses as one of twelve evaluated bias categories.
findings: Religion bias was found to have a low frequency of occurrence (2.6%) in model responses, compared to other more prevalent biases such as stereotype bias (31.1%) and cultural bias (17.3%).
